EVP_DigestFinal: Finish SHA-256 and reset the context in this OpenSSL profile.
EVP_DigestFinal_ex: Finish SHA-256 and retain the digest selection for reinitialization.
close: Release the named descriptor on success.
dup: Return a new descriptor for the same open file description and preserve the original.
sqlite3_close: Return BUSY while prepared statements remain live. On success close the connection.
sqlite3_close_v2: On success retire the caller's connection handle and defer final closure while statements remain.
